India Expands Digital Payments to Greece

India has launched its Unified Payments Interface (UPI) in Greece, enabling instant money transfers. This move marks a significant expansion of India's digital payments capabilities abroad. The UPI is a popular payment system in India, and its international launch is seen as a step towards promoting digital inclusion globally.
